faqLeft.q: What engine does the Land Rover Discovery HSE use?
faqLeft.a: The HSE is a trim level, not a specific engine. Discovery HSE models from the D3 and D4 generations (2004–2016) can have TDV6, SDV6, Si6, TDV8 or SDV8 engines. Enter your registration and we'll confirm which one your car has.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Land Rover Discovery HSE engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,400 for the V6 engines (TDV6, SDV6, Si6) and from £4,500 for the V8 diesels (TDV8, SDV8). Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my Discovery HSE?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have the TDV6, SDV6, Si6, TDV8 or SDV8 before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild TDV6 and SDV6 Discovery HSE engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes — these are our most common Discovery HSE rebuilds. Timing chain tensioner wear, injector seal leaks and crankshaft bearing failure risk are all addressed as standard.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild TDV8 and SDV8 Discovery HSE engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes — these V8 diesels share the same timing chain and injector pattern as the TDV6/SDV6 family and are serviced to the same high standard.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Discovery HSE engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Discovery HSE if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a Discovery HSE engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most Discovery HSE owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.

form.guarantee: Most quotes returned within 30 minutes during working hours.
